custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test at the test location, with a part number that has a hyphen in it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425677-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425677-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number holds the lower-case number.

Step 4:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The part is not saved.
  • A red message reads part A's part number, in part A's own upper and lower case, followed by "already exists at this location."
  • A second, smaller line under it reads "Please try to resolve this."
  • The message goes away after about 3 seconds, and the window stays open with the typed values.

Step 7:

  • Part Number holds the new text.

Step 8:

  • The same red message appears: hyphens, periods and spaces make no difference.

Step 9:

  • The window closes.

Step 10:

  • Exactly one row is listed: part A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S7-N3: “If a part with the same number is already stocked at this location and is active, the save is refused with "{part number} already exists at this location."”
  • S7-N5: “For S7-N3 and S7-N4, "the same number" ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods, spaces and other blank characters. The message names the number of the part already there.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “New part's number already stocked here, active | "{part number} already exists at this location." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”
  • Key Decisions: “A new part number already stocked at the location is refused, ignoring case and punctuation. This check stops a second copy of a part at one location. It runs when a part is created or its number is changed, never when a part is saved with its number unchanged. It is separate from linking, which stays exact.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.5 The same number again, in lower case". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-05-p1-5-duplicate-refused.png

The design's own words:

  • “Typing f40010212 at a location that already stocks F40010212 is refused with "F40010212 already exists at this location." (S7-N3). Upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored, and the message names the number of the part already there (S7-N5). The second line, "Please try to resolve this.", is the caption every error toast in the app carries.”
